title: El euro, el Banco de España y los servicios bancarios cotidianos (IBAN y Bizum)

words.translation: the euro (€, Spain's official currency since 2002)
the peseta (Spain's former currency from 1868 to 2002)
Bank of Spain (national central bank, integrated into the Eurosystem)
International Bank Account Number (24 characters starting with ES in Spain)
direct debit (automatic payment of bills from a bank account)
